description: SFLOW Thacker bowl (planar sloshing, h0 0.1 m, a 1 m, A 251 0.1) on 0.1 m cells, one level of patches following the shoreline (G 22, regrid every 4 steps): the shoreline crosses the box edges as the water runs up and recedes, the trailing side is coarsened while it holds the film the receding water leaves (above A 244). The restriction leaves a parent of dry film-holding children dry, the fresh children of a dry parent above the film take its water level.
covers: sflow_amr::restrict_level: the wet flag of the parent from the wet children
sflow_amr::ini_block: the water level of a dry parent above the film
